Founded in 1909, Bellin College has a distinguished reputation for providing students with a quality education which prepares them for the demands of the rapidly changing health care environment. The College has continually restructured its nursing program and also added a radiologic sciences program to meet health care changes. This devotion is seen in Bellin College's rich heritage and commitment to nursing and education. 

Bellin College is dedicated to preparing health-care professionals by providing an intellectually stimulating environment focused on leadership, community service, and lifelong learning that promotes excellence in health-care practice and the advancement of the profession.
